method: Public HTTPS documentation and raw source fetched read-only, with textual/API/source inspection. No logged-in products, owner browser, screenshot measurements or source clones. Full page bodies are excluded from the deliverable. Successful fetch is not a semantic claim validator.
limitations: Documentation URLs are dated observations, not immutable archives. Recheck before implementation.
Some catalogue and product URLs were redirects, errors or JavaScript shells. Family Sources explicitly scope not-found results to checked pages; no unavailable API option is counted.
Material 3 uses official Compose documentation and pinned AndroidX source where the design site was not readable. Experimental components are counted separately.
Apple HIG uses official documentation JSON as its readable counterpart and is guidance, not a web-component implementation count.
Current Polaris web components replace older React component URLs in this catalogue. React Aria/Spectrum 2, Chakra/Ark and Ant Design/Ant Design X each count as one requested system.
